item.title: Pezeshkian: Enemy plot to bring Iran to its knees through economic pressure foiled
item.description: “Our security and military forces responded forcefully,” the president says, while crediting investors and producers with preventing shortages and keeping production running.

item.title: Iranian institute urges UNICEF to condemn US-Israeli attacks that killed, injured children
item.description: The institute calls for documenting violations, establishing responsibility, and informing affected families of the findings.

item.title: Iran cuts foreign trade decline to 20%, clears border queues despite blockade
item.description: Economy Minister Madanizadeh says structural customs reforms and a shift to overland routes have stabilized trade.

item.title: IRGC announces downing of 58th US MQ-9 drone over Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran's Islamic Revolution Guards Corps announces the destruction of a 58th US military MQ-9 drone over the Strait of Hormuz using a newly deployed air defense system.

item.title: Iran FM outlines proposal to US, says seeks honorable agreement preventing return to war
item.description: Iranian foreign minister says Washington needs to take concrete confidence-building measures and agree to a sustainable deal that prevents a return to conflict.

item.title: IRGC Navy: Offending tanker explodes after striking mine near Oman’s Khasab port
item.description: The IRGC Navy says an oil tanker attempting to cross the Strait of Hormuz exploded after striking mines near the entrance to Oman’s Khasab Port.

item.title: Araghchi: Iran will make every effort to export oil, break US blockade
item.description: The Iranian foreign minister says the US blockade on Iran must be broken.

item.title: Leader’s advisor: Repression of Shia clerics will widen rift between Bahraini regime and people
item.description: A senior advisor to the Leader of the Islamic Revolution says suppression of Shia clerics will widen the gap between the Bahraini regime and people.

item.title: Iran's military capabilities put US in a quandary: Ex-British commander
item.description: Washington’s troop deployments and military build-up raise questions over whether the moves amount to saber-rattling or signal preparations for an attack, while Iran’s retaliatory capabilities and missile power may have factored into US calculations against launching an all-out war.

item.title: IRGC chief: ‘World no longer a safe haven for enemies who committed crimes against Iran’
item.description: He recalled that the adversaries subsequently predicted Iran’s political system would collapse within two weeks, but their expectations were not fulfilled.

item.title: Iran has ‘fingers on trigger’ to respond to enemy miscalculation: IRGC official
item.description: An advisor to the commander of the IRGC Aerospace Force warns that Iranian Armed Forces remain at the highest level of readiness, awaiting any foolish act by the adversary.

item.title: Araghchi ridicules Israeli envoy for acting as ‘commander-in-chief’ of US military
item.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi mocks Israeli envoy as “the Commander-in-Chief of the US Military.”

item.title: Saudi escalation targets Al-Mokha port, telecommunications networks, causing civilian casualties
item.description: Saudi aircraft targeted Yemen's Al-Mokha port in Taiz with several airstrikes, hitting one of the vital facilities on the western coast, in conjunction with eight airstrikes on Al-Mokha district.

item.title: French protesters rally for sixth weekend over living costs, public services
item.description: France saw nationwide demonstrations for the sixth weekend in a row on Saturday, as protesters took to the streets to demand better public services and express anger over the rising cost of living and inequality.

item.title: Three Palestinians killed in Israeli strike on World Central Kitchen bus in Gaza
item.description: Three Palestinians were killed and others injured on Saturday in an Israeli strike on a charity kitchen bus carrying meals for displaced people - including children - in Tel al-Hawa, southwest of Gaza City.
